quality.review_scope: Actual source-first text and original-page visual reading of all 8 main pages. Main-only operational TGA synthesis, film preparation, distinct optical and stability specimens, controls and projected device comparison. SI/external sources excluded; formal complete-paper Reader not claimed.
missing_fields: Main article pages1-8 are the eligible source scope. Matching local SI exists but its strict-screen decision is no_target_recipe and no positive source-specific resolution was found; SI remains unread/excluded. External cited methods are not imported.
General recipe, selected optical specimens and unquantified comparisons retain distinct sample scopes. No exact physical batch or missing growth duration is inferred.
No source-curve digitization, atom model or unreported chemical/particle/film geometry is reconstructed.
Reported uncertainty signs are retained without inventing standard-deviation or standard-error meanings.
TG/MPA comparative contexts cannot inherit this quantified TGA recipe.
Reflux duration, atmosphere, NaOH amount, ethanol amount, drying time and yield unreported.
conflicts: Main p.2 Materials names sodium tellurite; the Methods formula is printed NaTeO3. The literal formula is not silently changed to Na2TeO3.
